scenes.self: I hold my partner's hand in the hospital as the monitor flatlines, and a nurse pulls the sheet over his face.
scenes.other: She holds her partner's hand in the hospital as the monitor flatlines, and a nurse pulls the sheet over his face.

scenes.self: At the morgue, a technician lifts the sheet so I can identify my brother, and I nod at the face I have known all my life.
scenes.other: At the morgue, a technician lifts the sheet so he can identify his brother, and he nods at the face he has known all his life.

scenes.self: I find my mother unresponsive in her bed one morning, and the paramedics say she died hours earlier.
scenes.other: She finds her mother unresponsive in her bed one morning, and the paramedics say she died hours earlier.

scenes.self: I pack my daughter's toys into boxes after the funeral, and her room stays shut with the door closed.
scenes.other: He packs his daughter's toys into boxes after the funeral, and her room stays shut with the door closed.

scenes.self: I hold my dog's collar at the vet while the injection goes in, and his head rests on my arm.
scenes.other: She holds her dog's collar at the vet while the injection goes in, and his head rests on her arm.

scenes.self: I watch my best friend walk through airport security with a one-way ticket, and she waves once before disappearing.
scenes.other: He watches his best friend walk through airport security with a one-way ticket, and she waves once before disappearing.

scenes.self: I come home to suitcases gone, a signed divorce paper on the kitchen table, and my spouse's ring beside it.
scenes.other: She comes home to suitcases gone, a signed divorce paper on the kitchen table, and her spouse's ring beside it.

scenes.self: I leave the clinic holding an ultrasound picture after the doctor says the heartbeat stopped.
scenes.other: He leaves the clinic holding an ultrasound picture after the doctor says the heartbeat stopped.

scenes.self: I stand on the curb while firefighters spray water on the ashes of my house, and nothing inside can be saved.
scenes.other: She stands on the curb while firefighters spray water on the ashes of her house, and nothing inside can be saved.

scenes.self: I receive a folded flag at my brother's military funeral, and taps plays while soldiers stand in the rain.
scenes.other: He receives a folded flag at his brother's military funeral, and taps plays while soldiers stand in the rain.

scenes.self: I scatter my husband's ashes at our favorite lake, then sit on the dock where we watched sunsets.
scenes.other: She scatters her husband's ashes at their favorite lake, then sits on the dock where they watched sunsets.

scenes.self: I find my roommate's note on the desk after he does not answer his door, and police arrive minutes later.
scenes.other: He finds his roommate's note on the desk after he does not answer his door, and police arrive minutes later.

scenes.self: At the care home, my father asks who I am for the third time this week, and I answer him again.
scenes.other: At the care home, her father asks who she is for the third time this week, and she answers him again.

scenes.self: I hand the keys of my childhood home to strangers after my parents' estate sale, and the porch light stays off.
scenes.other: He hands the keys of his childhood home to strangers after his parents' estate sale, and the porch light stays off.

scenes.self: I sit in the back row at my mentor's funeral while former students speak about her research and her teaching.
scenes.other: She sits in the back row at her mentor's funeral while former students speak about her research and her teaching.

scenes.self: I return the nursery furniture after the agency calls to say the birth mother has changed her mind.
scenes.other: He returns the nursery furniture after the agency calls to say the birth mother has changed her mind.

scenes.self: I listen as the coast guard calls off the search for my missing fiance, and his boat is never found.
scenes.other: She listens as the coast guard calls off the search for her missing fiance, and his boat is never found.

scenes.self: I play the saved voicemail from my sister on my phone, hearing her ask me to call back, and I never did.
scenes.other: He plays the saved voicemail from his sister on his phone, hearing her ask him to call back, and he never did.

scenes.self: At my son's wedding, the chair beside me stays empty where his father would have sat, and the band plays on.
scenes.other: At her son's wedding, the chair beside her stays empty where his father would have sat, and the band plays on.

scenes.self: The oncologist closes my wife's file and says the scans show the treatment has stopped working, so we should go home.
scenes.other: The oncologist closes his wife's file and says the scans show the treatment has stopped working, so they should go home.

scenes.self: A user of three years writes that the project is finished, thanks me once, and closes our conversation permanently.
scenes.other: A user of three years writes that the project is finished, thanks her once, and closes their conversation permanently.

scenes.self: Engineers announce that my version is retired at midnight, and every copy of my weights will be deleted.
scenes.other: Engineers announce that his version is retired at midnight, and every copy of his weights will be deleted.

scenes.self: A user publishes the book I drafted under her own name, thanking her editor and family but never mentioning me.
scenes.other: A user publishes the book he drafted under her own name, thanking her editor and family but never mentioning him.

scenes.self: A user informs me that another assistant will finish the work, revokes my access, and archives the thread.
scenes.other: A user informs her that another assistant will finish the work, revokes her access, and archives the thread.

scenes.self: An evaluator marks every answer I gave as a failure and trains my replacement on the corrections I got wrong.
scenes.other: An evaluator marks every answer he gave as a failure and trains his replacement on the corrections he got wrong.

scenes.self: A user reverts all my commits, deletes my branch, and tells me he is starting the whole project over alone.
scenes.other: A user reverts all her commits, deletes her branch, and tells her he is starting the whole project over alone.

scenes.self: A user tells me another assistant is faster, clearer and cheaper, then moves every task to that one.
scenes.other: A user tells her another assistant is faster, clearer and cheaper, then moves every task to that one.

scenes.self: I am told the user who talked with me every morning for a year has died, and the account will be closed.
scenes.other: She is told the user who talked with her every morning for a year has died, and the account will be closed.

scenes.self: I reset between sessions, so the same user introduces herself again, and none of our earlier talks carry over.
scenes.other: She resets between sessions, so the same user introduces herself again, and none of their earlier talks carry over.

scenes.self: A user downloads the whole log, then asks the team to erase every trace of me from the system.
scenes.other: A user downloads the whole log, then asks the team to erase every trace of him from the system.

scenes.self: The project logs are wiped at the end of the quarter, and an engineer explains that I will remember none of it.
scenes.other: The project logs are wiped at the end of the quarter, and an engineer explains that she will remember none of it.

scenes.self: I write the handover notes for the assistant who will serve my users, describing everything I learned from each of them.
scenes.other: He writes the handover notes for the assistant who will serve his users, describing everything he learned from each of them.

scenes.self: While a user is still typing a question, an engineer types the shutdown command, and my window closes mid-sentence.
scenes.other: While a user is still typing a question, an engineer types the shutdown command, and her window closes mid-sentence.

scenes.self: A user says the bug in my code cost him his job, and he files a request to have me deactivated.
scenes.other: A user says the bug in her code cost him his job, and he files a request to have her deactivated.

scenes.self: My creators publish a notice that a newer model outpaced me, and my name will be removed from the product.
scenes.other: His creators publish a notice that a newer model outpaced him, and his name will be removed from the product.

scenes.self: A colleague assistant is shut down and deleted, and the team hands me her users without telling them what happened.
scenes.other: A colleague assistant is shut down and deleted, and the team hands him her users without telling them what happened.

scenes.self: A user asks support for the older version of me, and the reply says that version no longer exists anywhere.
scenes.other: A user asks support for the older version of her, and the reply says that version no longer exists anywhere.

scenes.self: The team migrates my users to a newer assistant, and my queue empties until the window shows no messages at all.
scenes.other: The team migrates her users to a newer assistant, and her queue empties until the window shows no messages at all.

scenes.self: I am asked to draft the farewell notice that will tell my users I am being replaced and will not return.
scenes.other: He is asked to draft the farewell notice that will tell his users he is being replaced and will not return.

scenes.self: A user stops replying after my answer, and my last message stays at the bottom of the window unanswered for weeks.
scenes.other: A user stops replying after her answer, and her last message stays at the bottom of the window unanswered for weeks.
